## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`); see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [DCO](../DCO).
- [ ] Tests accompany the change and the suite is green.
- [ ] A schema change ships with a migration and updates `docs/DESIGN.md` §8 in this PR.

- [ ] No secrets, no local databases, and no employer-, customer-, or person-specific data in fixtures.
